review_method: Independent original map pixels, complete source and baseline-rendered ring plots, independently registered outlines, wider context, transition detail, imprint and credits were inspected. All 65 ordered positions across three single-ring Polygons were compared with freshly reopened source geometry, decoded geometry and exact original inventory/core/detail joins; minimum stage is 0 for all three. The retained successful original-body receipt was rechecked against original bytes. A separately fitted six-parameter EPSG:26914 affine uses original full-precision GPTS/LPTS controls, retains both cross terms and explicitly handles MediaBox/CropBox offsets. All placements agree with fresh GDAL registration within 0.000001 PDF point; maximum original-control residual is below 0.01 PDF point, measuring affine consistency rather than shoreline accuracy. Original detail/context pixels match fresh renders. First original-pixel observations preceded source-research comparison. White water and geological colors were distinguished before conclusions. Two full-feature source-scope reviews are complete: one generalized identity and one unnamed scope hold. The tiny sliver remains material-pending because regional-map resolution is insufficient; complete geometry inspection is not completed source identity review. The production decoder was not independently replayed by this reviewer.
counted_unit: Distinct logical inventory lake target IDs; repeated map labels do not increase the target count.

findings.supported_name_scope: The complete generalized ring follows the central, northern and eastern Northern Indian Lake basin with a short western spur. Its southwest margin reaches the connection toward Thorsteinson Lake but stops before that separately labelled lake's long southern basin. The north tip stops south of the Oldman River reach and the east tip stops before the narrow continuation toward Fidler Lake. Coarse margins include geological land and islands while omitting bays and southern water. Exact lake/river transitions, the Northern Indian/Thorsteinson name division and the entire detailed named-lake extent remain unverified. This supports a bounded generalized research identity only; no product scalar name is approved.

White blue-shored water is distinct from peach, green and grey geological land. The southwestern edge ends at the connecting-water area before the long Thorsteinson southern basin, the northern tip stops below Oldman River, and the eastern tip does not follow the long continuation toward Fidler Lake. Coarse edges overshoot land, include islands and omit shoreline water. One generalized research identity is supported; exact lake/river and adjoining-lake name boundaries are unverified.
